description: ★Development of image processing algorithms for AD/ADAS and robotics Business Level Japanese REQURIED ◆ Hybrid Work ◆ Listed Company ◆ Global Business ◆ Annual Salary： 6 million ～ 10 million yen. -------------【About the company】------------- The company is a software company whose corporate message is "Speed up your Business. They accelerate their customers' businesses in various fields such as medical, manufacturing, finance, and entertainment by parallelizing and optimizing software to efficiently utilize multi-core processors and accelerating applications using new memory technology that realizes power saving and high-speed IO, thereby achieving green IT. -------------【 Job Description】------------- 【Overview】 Development and acceleration of image processing algorithms for achieving autonomous driving in vehicles and robots. As the realization of autonomous driving for vehicles and robots approaches, the importance of image processing technology continues to grow. The company develops image processing algorithms using a wide range of methods, from 3D image processing such as SLAM and SfM to AI-based image recognition utilizing CNNs and Vision Transformers. In designing image processing algorithms specifically for embedded applications, execution speed is just as critical as accuracy; therefore, the company develops these algorithms by leveraging extensive expertise to strike an optimal balance between the two. 【Responsibilities】 ・Researching the latest papers on image processing algorithms. ・Designing image processing algorithms. ・Developing recognition AI models and performing model compression. ・Optimizing image processing algorithms for specific hardware. 【Scope of Change in Duties】 All duties as defined by the company. -------------【 Requirements】------------- 【MUST HAVE】 ・C/C++ ・Image processing algorithm development using OpenCV ・Experience in image processing research and development 【NICE TO HAVE】 ・Python ・AI model development using frameworks like PyTorch ・Experience in AI model compression and acceleration ・Implementation of image processing algorithms independent of OpenCV ・GPU acceleration for image processing using CUDA -------------------------------------------------- 【Working Hours】 Discretionary Labor System 【Holidays】 ・Saturday/Sunday/National Holiday ・Annual Paid Leave ・New Year Holiday 【Welfare】 ・Full Social Insurance ・Commuting Allowance ・Child Allowance ・Recreation Assistance ・Training/Self Development Allowance ・Outside resident allowance of 30,000 yen/month ・Travel and accommodation expenses for company trips ・Company expenses for social gatherings ・Maintenance fee for club activities (e.g., ski club: 60,000 yen per person per year; other clubs include golf, futsal, and board game clubs) -------------------------------------------------------------------------
